items.title: For a proper morphism the small pushforward composes with the h-comparison to the big one
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the h-topology version of the proper push-pull identity, deduced from the etale case (statement lines 22615-22619). The proof (proof lines 22621-22645) reduces by reflection of isomorphisms through epsilon_{Y,*} and the description of the pullbacks, then identifies the composite with part (1) of the comparison lemma for proper morphisms. H2: one reduction and one identification.
